comments.author: @BeyondTheMapTV1
comments.text: Slab City is fascinating because it turns the idea of “freedom” into something much more complicated. 🏜🚐 No rent and very little formal structure may sound liberating, but water, extreme heat, healthcare and basic services suddenly become personal responsibilities. The community is a good example of how escaping conventional systems often means creating new informal ones to survive.
